statement: A focused cross-layer TLA+ model proves that an exact completed target-election acknowledgment is recorded and routed in the same owner turn through canonical remove safety before retry expiry can retarget it, while a delayed-continuation mutant violates exact-evidence terminality and a continuation-authorizes-removal mutant violates the safety-owner/interlock invariant.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Model only target-election dispatch, exact response recording, continuation routing, retry expiry/retarget, canonical remove-safety guards, and serialized interlock acquisition; do not claim exhaustive repository layer coverage.
The fixed model must distinguish continuation from remove authorization and require canonical voter, quorum, membership, leadership, peer-contact, and interlock guards before removal.

Delayed continuation must admit an exact-evidence retarget counterexample, and continuation-owned authorization must admit an unsafe or unserialized removal counterexample, while the fixed configuration passes.
This proof-package Quest must not change runtime policy, retry duration, live budgets, workload, joins, preload, quorum, membership, or serialized interlock semantics.
